title: CRDT property tests: commutativity/idempotency/convergence, 1000 cases each
description: core/tests/crdt_properties.rs runs property-based tests covering all four algebraic properties required of the Merkle-CRDT: commutativity, associativity, idempotency, and convergence after partition. Each property runs 1000+ generated cases. The doc comments name the property being tested and explain why it must hold. A contributor might suggest replacing these with simpler, faster example-based tests — that would miss entire classes of ordering and concurrency bugs that only manifest with specific generated sequences. These tests justify the Merkle-CRDT design choice and guard against regressions during any future reconcile() changes.
